items.summary: Anyone who voluntarily provided a DNA sample to police in Ontario at any point during a 22-year period might be eligible for compensation due to a class-action lawsuit.

items.title: Toronto police arrest correctional officer for allegedly posing as a cop
items.summary: Toronto police have arrested a correctional officer from the Toronto South Detention Centre for allegedly posing as an OPP officer.

items.title: City of Mississauga pauses all hiring until at least March 2027
items.summary: The City of Mississauga is pausing all hiring until at least next spring in an effort to keep costs down and make good on a promise to implement a zero per cent tax increase in the 2027 and 2028 budgets.

items.title: 91-year-old man arrested in string of Burlington sexual assaults
items.summary: A 91-year-old man has been arrested after police say that he committed five separate sexual assaults in Burlington over a five-month span.

items.title: Serbian police arrest a 17-year-old after shots fired at a high school
items.summary: Police arrested a teenager in central Serbia on Tuesday after he fired a small-calibre rifle in a high school hallway.

items.title: House Democrat expands investigation into Donald Trump Jr.'s investment firm
items.summary: A top U.S. House Democrat is broadening his investigation into Donald Trump Jr.’s venture capital fund 1789 Capital by demanding records from four companies that secured an investment before benefiting from lucrative federal contracts or policies.

items.title: It costs more than $1,200 a month to feed a family of 4 in Ottawa, new Hunger Report says
items.summary: The proportion of households in Ottawa that experienced food insecurity last year declined compared to the year before, but the Ottawa Food Bank says demand for its services shows no signs of slowing.

items.title: Ottawa proposes sweeping new land-seizure powers for Alto high-speed rail project
items.summary: The federal government is proposing to scrap standard expropriation rules for Canada's first high-speed rail project.

items.title: Ullmark leads Senators to 2-1 win over Flames
